hints: Apply integration by parts to \(\int_1^4 x^{3/2}\ln x\,dx\), choosing \(u=\ln x\) and \(dv=x^{3/2}dx\).
Use \(du=dx/x\) and \(v=\tfrac25x^{5/2}\), then simplify the remaining power integral completely.
Evaluate the full antiderivative at 4 and 1, keeping \(\ln4=2\ln2\) so the result remains exact.
walkthrough:
State the given definite integral:
$$I = \int_1^4 x^{3/2}\ln x\,dx$$

Apply integration by parts using the formula $\int u\,dv = uv - \int v\,du$:
Choose $u = \ln x$ (to be differentiated) and $dv = x^{3/2}\,dx$ (to be integrated).

Integrate $dv$ using the power rule $\int x^n\,dx = \dfrac{x^{n+1}}{n+1}$ with $n = \dfrac{3}{2}$:
$$v = \dfrac{x^{3/2 + 1}}{\frac{3}{2} + 1} = \dfrac{x^{5/2}}{\frac{5}{2}} = \dfrac{2}{5}x^{5/2}$$

Substitute $u, v, du$ into the integration by parts formula:
$$\int x^{3/2}\ln x\,dx = \left( \ln x \right)\left( \dfrac{2}{5}x^{5/2} \right) - \int \left( \dfrac{2}{5}x^{5/2} \right)\left( \dfrac{1}{x} \right)\,dx$$
$$= \dfrac{2}{5}x^{5/2}\ln x - \dfrac{2}{5}\int x^{3/2}\,dx$$

Compute the remaining integral $\int x^{3/2}\,dx$:
$$\int x^{3/2}\,dx = \dfrac{2}{5}x^{5/2}$$

Multiply by the constant factor $-\dfrac{2}{5}$ to find the full antiderivative $F(x)$:
$$-\dfrac{2}{5}\left(\dfrac{2}{5}x^{5/2}\right) = -\dfrac{4}{25}x^{5/2}$$
$$F(x) = \dfrac{2}{5}x^{5/2}\ln x - \dfrac{4}{25}x^{5/2}$$

Evaluate the antiderivative at the upper limit $x = 4$:
Compute $4^{5/2} = (\sqrt{4})^5 = 2^5 = 32$.
$$F(4) = \dfrac{2}{5}(32)\ln(4) - \dfrac{4}{25}(32) = \dfrac{64}{5}\ln(4) - \dfrac{128}{25}$$

Evaluate the antiderivative at the lower limit $x = 1$:
Since $\ln(1) = 0$ and $1^{5/2} = 1$:
$$F(1) = \dfrac{2}{5}(1)(0) - \dfrac{4}{25}(1) = 0 - \dfrac{4}{25} = -\dfrac{4}{25}$$

State the exact value of the integral:
$$I = \dfrac{128}{5}\ln 2 - \dfrac{124}{25}$$

ai_rubric.Integration: Integration begins with \(ax^{5/2}\ln x+b\int x^{5/2}\frac1x\,dx\). Completes the integration and derives \(\frac25x^{5/2}\ln x-\frac4{25}x^{5/2}\), or equivalent. Concludes with \(\displaystyle\frac{128}{5}\ln2-\frac{124}{25}\).
